evidence: Read “They still have to answer for what they did, and it still hurt, even if you see how they got there. It’s just that punishing them now can’t reach back…”: accountability, the hurt and “understanding doesn’t excuse it” are all in the one sentence (the “even if” covers both clauses), “you see how they got there” matches the previous paragraph’s “seeing how a person… shaped the harmful move” and “When you see it for yourself”, and “It’s just that” now qualifies the accountability line and still leads into “punishing them now can’t reach back”, so no pronoun or point goes missing. The short knock-down is gone and no not-X/it’s-Y, closer or reassurance is made; the “still… still” sentence stays as the first sentence already was. Linter: B1 accepted, since the sentence is about these people and this harm with the concession as a clause, whereas the maxim (“Seeing how they got there doesn’t make it okay”) is the part that went; D9 is by design (same paragraph, one tell out).
